description.value:
Plant it as an Action and roll DV17 Demolitions. Success: 8d6 when it blows, like an Armor-Piercing Grenade. Failure: 5d6. It arms after 10 Rounds. Set it for remote detonation (within a mile, an Action) or a countdown (instant to one week). Defusing it is an Action against a DV equal to the planting Check; a failed defuse or moving the charge sets it off.

Item Compendium (2070) • Ammo & Explosives
